concept.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A NEW utility SPACECRAFT for OpenFA, an isometric real-time strategy game, concept reference for an economical 3D game model. Strict complexity target: match the accepted simple Terran v3 reference, only 4â€“6 large visual masses, a compact silhouette, a few broad colour areas, almost no small detail. Must remain recognizable at 64â€“96 pixels wide. Clean solid beveled manufactured shapes, restrained late-1990s pre-rendered RTS sensibility, subtle material wear, legible soft studio highlights. Do not add complexity to make it look sophisticated.
Input reference roles: image 1 is the ORIGINAL game's units of THIS culture: PRIMARY reference for palette, material character and broad cultural form language. It is not a literal geometry template. Image 2 is the accepted simplified TERRAN reference: ONLY a limit on complexity, framing and surface-detail density, never a palette or faction identity reference. Do not recolour a Terran model. Design a new industrial silhouette fitting this culture and the role.
Exactly ONE complete spacecraft, elevated front three-quarter view, centered with generous margins, all parts visible. Uniform pure black backdrop without ground, environment, people, extra craft or cast floor shadow. No text, labels, logos, watermark, contact sheet, weapons, wheels, tracks or walking legs. Clearly space/hover capable. Minimal functional moving parts and large uninterrupted panels; idle tools. Subtle seam dirt, contact scuffing, a few worn paint edges, small dents suited to material. NO exposed cable bundles, pipes, rivet fields, fine greebles, decorative antennas, rails, shelves, cargo clutter, cockpit interior, myriad lights, intricate engraving, cinematic photoreal mechanical complexity or glowing magical effects.
Culture: rigellian. Elegant satin silver/pale blue-green alloy, muted green broad panels, small warm yellow-gold caps and copper connection rims, following the actual reference ships. Smooth balanced ergonomic shapes; advanced precision expressed through simplicity. No Terran red stripes, no crystals.
Subject: REPAIR AND CONSTRUCTION-ASSIST SHIP. A lighter compact rounded capsule, smooth pale green-silver body and two small integrated rear propulsion nacelles. ONE pair of simple gently curved two-segment arms under the front: a copper-rimmed lifting clamp and a short precision joining nozzle. Small gold dorsal insert, no human cockpit. The two arms clearly support building repair and new construction assembly. Keep large quiet surfaces and clean balanced silhouette.
